Listener: %s

danmaku.coverage: The live API does not guarantee offline replay. Boundary markers indicate possible gaps.
danmaku.empty: No messages yet. Incoming events are saved before display, even on other tabs.
danmaku.no_room: Sign in to auto-listen to your room. Saved local history is available offline.
danmaku.reconnecting: Disconnected, retrying automatically; messages may be missed
danmaku.storage_error: History write failed! Retrying the retained message; the connection may drop and exiting may lose unsaved messages
danmaku.error: Listener unavailable; press r to retry
danmaku.history_error: History unavailable (another instance or storage failure); press r to retry: %s
danmaku.session_start: —— Connecting; messages between the previous disconnect and authentication may be missing ——
danmaku.session_end: —— Listener stopped; messages are not received while stopped ——
danmaku.connection_lost: —— Connection lost; messages may be missed during reconnection ——
danmaku.retry: Checking listener status and refreshing history
danmaku.toggle_confirm: Disable listening? History is kept, but messages while disabled are not received and replay is not guaranteed.
danmaku.privacy: Chat and raw events stay in the local config directory without automatic pruning. Consider privacy and disk space.
